current: Large two-storey cave system in Kırklareli with a total length of 2,720 m; its lowest level, Sulu Cave, lies 345 m above sea level.
proposed: Large two-storey show cave in Kırklareli made up of three caves (Kuru, Kız and Sulu); the lowest, Sulu Cave, lies 345 m above sea level.
note: Go Türkiye (cited) says 'total length of 2,720 m', but English Wikipedia gives total 3,200 m and 2,720 m only for the upper level (Kuru + Kız); the two sources conflict, so the length is dropped. 345 m (Sulu Cave) and 'two-storey', 'three caves' are confirmed by both Go Türkiye (https://goturkiye.com/kirklareli/touch) and Wikipedia.

current: The Kocaeli tourism directorate says Hannibal's tomb lies inside the TÜBİTAK campus in Gebze; after defeat at Zama he took refuge in Bithynia.
proposed: The Kocaeli tourism directorate says Hannibal's tomb lies inside the TÜBİTAK campus in Gebze; after the Second Punic War he lived in exile at the court of Bithynia and died there.
note: The tomb claim is correctly attributed to the directorate (kocaeli.ktb.gov.tr says exactly this), keep the attribution. But 'after Zama he took refuge in Bithynia' compresses the history: after Zama (202 BC) he went to the Seleucid court (Antiochus III), then Crete/Armenia, and reached Bithynia only after ~190 BC. Wikipedia 'Libyssa' also notes the location of Libyssa and the tomb is debated.
